sections.chapter_title: Controller area network with flexible data rate (FDCAN)
sections.text_helper: Section 71.4.24 "FDCAN trigger memory element" in chapter 71 (Controller area network with flexible data rate (FDCAN)), RM0486 Rev 4, page 3679.
sections.section_content:
Up to 64 trigger memory elements can be configured. When accessing a trigger memory
element, its address is the trigger memory start address FDCAN_TTTMC.TMSA plus the
index of the trigger memory element (0 … 63).
